purpose: Official faculty-career hubs scanned for newly posted HCI, XR, spatial-computing, and human-AI faculty searches before manual fit review.

sources.institution: The University of Texas at Austin
sources.auditNote: All current faculty postings were searched through the university's own index, including descriptions rather than titles alone.

The complete public UC Recruit listing is inspected, and eligible Assistant/Open-rank faculty descriptions are checked for research-fit signals. JPF05409 is manually excluded because it is a theatrical-design search rather than an HCI/XR research-faculty search.
